release_notes: Test release of mwongj/VOD2MLIB PR #5, including the A Different World ownership-cleanup fix. Both active filters and enabled Emby ownership cleanup now archive confirmed excluded NFO-only folders, preserving legacy/Emby metadata outside library roots with a recovery manifest. Ownership archival covers movies and whole-show mode even when a title passes all filters, follows existing cleanup scope/timing and identity protections, and preserves series folders in episode mode. Preview accounts for planned STRM/NFO removal without double counting; ownership and filter archives have separate result/telemetry counters. Saved settings and defaults remain unchanged. Validation: 457 Linux tests passed; Python 3.10 and 3.12 CI passed; real Dispatcharr/Emby validation against 191,077 native relations correctly previewed and archived an A Different World fixture while preserving its metadata and saved settings. RC.1 live movie generation archived and verified 5,366 legacy NFO-only folders with zero errors and zero remaining rejected NFO-only folders. No Dispatcharr source changes. Upgrade to RC.2, use Preview selective cleanup or run normal generation/selective cleanup with current settings, then rescan Emby. Metadata backups are retained under /data/vod2mlib/filtered-nfo (or the configured state directory).
